messages.text: Our office espresso machine is leaking. A wants a simpler one and B wants to keep the old one. I don't want a fight over coffee. Can you help us sort it out?

My main concern is having a machine that’s simple and low-upkeep. I’d be glad to keep the grinder if it works with the machine we choose. I’m not sure whether the leak is a safety issue, so perhaps facilities could check; if water is near power, please stop using it. After that, we could agree on a straightforward next step. I’m afraid I can’t take on repairs or a cleaning rota.

My main concern is keeping the old machine rather than replacing it. I want it repaired and kept, and the grinder kept if it works with it. A repair check is a reasonable next step, but it needs to fit a short time slot. I don’t know if water is near power; if it is, stop using it and call facilities.

My items are accurate. My main concern is getting safe, working coffee without a dispute. I need a working machine and grinder; I have no preference between old and new if they work together. A facilities safety check and repair check is an acceptable next step. I can’t take on arranging or doing the repair.

No corrections, though item 6 is a suggestion, not a confirmed check. I can make a 15-minute slot at lunchtime work if facilities can set the time. B brought the machine in, but I don’t know who legally owns it or the grinder; I also don’t know who can approve office work or spending. I don’t know if the leak is near power.
My items are accurate. I can’t name a time slot without checking my calendar. I don’t know who owns the machine or grinder, or who can approve office work and spending.

Yes to the safety pause and fact-finding check, but I can’t send the request. A or B would need to send it. I don’t know who owns the machine or grinder, who approves office spending, or where that information is kept.

Yes, the plan sounds fine. B bringing in the machine is accurate; I don’t know who owns either item or who approves office work and spending, or where that’s recorded. I can make a 15-minute lunchtime slot work if facilities sets the time. I could send one brief request, but I can’t manage a back-and-forth.

Yes to the plan. I can send the facilities request. I’m not sure I brought the machine in; it was our late father’s. I don’t know the official owners or who approves work and spending, or where that’s recorded. I’ll check my calendar for a 15-minute slot.
Yes to the next step. I don’t know which office role or record can name the owner and approver.
Yes, that next step works for me. A 15-minute lunchtime slot still works if facilities sets the time. I can’t take on repairs or a cleaning rota.
Yes to the safety and fact-finding check. I’ll ask facilities to set a time and make clear no work or spending is authorized. I need to check my calendar before I can give a 15-minute slot.
Understood. I’ll send the request as stated and check my calendar for a slot.
